title: Icing Encounter
failure_mode: Inadvertent encounter with structural icing conditions (visible moisture + OAT below freezing).
effect: Ice accumulation on wings and tail can increase stall speed by 15-30% and reduce control effectiveness.
cause: Flight continued into icing conditions in an aircraft that is NOT certified for flight into known icing (FIKI).
mitigation: Pitot heat; immediate 180° turn or descent
